# make: make --no-print-directory -n verdict RUN_ID=r1
# laug: laug verdict r1
# lease: present
# adds: VERDICT_JSON=load/results/r1.verdict.json
# compare: line load/verdict.sh
[[ 'r1' =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ ]] || { echo "laug · make verdict: RUN_ID="'r1'" is not one word of letters, digits, ., _ and -, from a letter or digit" >&2; exit 2; };                    
PROM_URL='' FALLBACK_PROM_URL='http://127.0.0.1:9100' load/verdict.sh r1
